purpose: Define the hard query/scan gate before any Ticket 25 performance result is collected.

syntheticFixture.identityRule: All ids are deterministic, unique within their owner and cross-linked only by explicit articleId/clientId fields.
syntheticFixture.transportRule: No network, browser, vendor, account, credential or production workspace is allowed; adapters are replaced by in-memory fakes.
syntheticFixture.fixtureRule: Each measured public call receives the same frozen fixture; generation and projection work is included, but fixture construction and JSON serialization are excluded from query/scan counters.

countBoundary.query: Count each call from the public batch/projection seam to a persistence or injected read capability. Do not count pure in-memory filtering, projection loops or cache hits.
countBoundary.scan: Count each logical directory/file/database collection read exposed by the fixture capability. Do not claim OS syscall telemetry.
countBoundary.transport: A Ticket 25 projection benchmark must use zero external transport calls; fake transport calls, if a later package measures an adapter, are counted separately and never treated as query savings.
countBoundary.nPlusOneFailure: Any query or scan count that grows with articles, queue items or orders, or exceeds its operation budget, is a hard failure even when wall-clock time looks acceptable.

protocol.sampleOrder: Run warmups first, then measured runs in ascending operation order; do not mix fixture sizes within a sample set.
protocol.repeatIsolation: Create a fresh in-memory read harness for every measured run and reset counters before the public call.
protocol.wallClock: Record p50 and p95 for observation only. No approved same-environment baseline exists in 25-A, so no wall-clock pass/fail threshold may be invented.
protocol.failureOutput: Write a safe report with status FAILED and the operation/counter that exceeded budget; do not include fixture contents, credentials or raw exceptions.

operations.hardRule: Counts stay constant as article/queue/order fixture counts scale within the frozen fixture.

operations.publicSeam: regular queue application public queue/read projection
operations.hardRule: One batch read per required persistence category; no per-item read for FIFO, current item or remaining order.
Order list/filter/count projection is batch-read; no per-order refresh or query is issued by a list operation.
